from .entries import Entry, parse_line
from .stats import summarise

__all__ = ["Entry", "parse_line", "summarise"]

import pytest

from harborlog import parse_line


def test_parse_line_good():
    entry = parse_line("2026-11-02T22:00:00Z | ch 16 | hello harbour")
    assert entry.ts == "2026-11-02T22:00:00Z"
    assert entry.channel == 16
    assert entry.text == "hello harbour"


def test_parse_line_malformed():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_line("this is not a valid log line")
